component: Flint B1 Q4 fused QKV and routed/shared expert decode candidate
modifications: Mined shader arithmetic only; no rec server, scheduler, model loader or prefix-cache engine.
Independent thread groups fuse RMS/QKV/QK-norm/RoPE, routed and shared gate/up/activation, and down/weighted-combine/residual. No grid barriers, spin loops or mutable kernel inputs.
Native mlx2 attention, sigmoid/argpartition router, dense first-two-layer MLPs, prefill and canonical APCv2 cache update remain the reference contracts.
FP32 affine input sums and single-round BF16 RMS output match the mlx2 fork transcription; explicit native top-k order and FP32 weighting preserve Flint combine semantics.
Own four-layer packed weight banks with aliasing ordinary parameters; bind bounded views of owned allocations using the existing one-expert-view resource-accounting mechanism.
First slice: BF16 activations/KV, uniform affine INT4g64 layers, B1 one-token decode, M3 Pro only; mixed-bit layers fail closed.
Failed resident-grid prototypes are retained only in exploratory evidence; no longer part of the runtime.

public_validation.scope: Source integration and focused synthetic CPU regressions; no model qualification or performance claim.
public_validation.evidence: Focused synthetic test modules distributed with this implementation; private campaign evidence is not distributed.
